messages:
Marta (Recruiter): New engineering manager offer accepted. Request: one compact 'manager onboarding sprint' that I can attach to the offer and hand to the hire on Day 1. Needs: day-by-day first-week checklist, a quick 30/60/90 paragraph set, 1:1 agenda snippet, and a who-to-contact cheat sheet. Keep it paste-ready.

Priya: Happy to build. Proposal: single-column checklist + three short 30/60/90 bullets + one-paragraph welcome. Will include owners and links.

Jordan (IT): FYI laptop provisioning 3 business days. If start date is next-week we can provision a temporary VM. Need legal name + personal email to pre-create SSO. Also note about VPN and corporate WiFi certs.

Sam (DevEx): I'll add CLI shortcuts to request GitHub/Jira/CI access and a one-liner to bootstrap local dev. Also will volunteer as infra escalations contact for first week.

Diego (Finance): Recommend adding a quick headcount & budget sync in week 2. I'll offer a 30-min template.

Priya: Draft below (copy/paste):

"Welcome blurb (paste into offer):
Welcome to Redwood! On Day 1 you'll have a 30-minute orientation with your hiring manager, team intros, and access to code, CI, and monitoring. We'll provide a 10-day leadership sprint plan and a draft 30/60/90 within the first 10 days so expectations are clear.

Compact Day-by-day checklist (who owns):
Day 0 (pre-start):
- Complete HR e-signs & benefits enrollment (People Ops)
- Confirm laptop shipping or enable managed VM (IT)
- Pre-invite to Slack, Google Workspace, Confluence (People Ops)

Day 1 AM:
- 30m orientation with hiring manager: role scope & top priorities (Manager)
- 15m team intro round (Manager)
- Laptop SSO + MFA + VPN certs (IT)

Day 1 PM:
- Access checklist: GitHub org, JIRA, CI tokens, Datadog, Redwood Console (DevEx/IT)
- Schedule weekly 1:1s & send 1:1 agenda template (Manager)

Days 2-5 (first week):
- Product roadmap + architecture deep-dive (Tech leads)
- 1:1s with direct reports + skip-level intro (Manager)
- Incident runbook walkthrough & paging simulation (Eng-SRE)
- Complete security/compliance quick courses (Security)
- Quick win: identify & unblock one priority ticket (Manager/New Hire)

By Day 10:
- Manager + hire share draft 30/60/90 and top 3 priorities (Manager/New Hire)
- Assign mentor/buddy and escalation contacts (Manager)

30/60/90 (paste-ready single lines):
- 30d: Understand team responsibilities, run recurring 1:1s, and close onboarding gaps.
- 60d: Deliver a committed milestone, propose at least one ops improvement, and ramp deploy privileges.
- 90d: Lead next-quarter planning, present hiring/resource asks, and own roadmap commitments.

One-page 1:1 agenda (first meeting):
- Quick personal check-in (5m)
- Role expectations & immediate priorities (10m)
- Support needs & blockers (10m)
- Next steps + cadence (5m)

Who to ping (fast):
- IT (Jordan): laptop / SSO / VPN / WiFi certs
- DevEx (Sam): repo invites, CI tokens, local dev bootstrap, deploy ramps
- People Ops (Nina): benefits, time-off, scheduling & onboarding tasks
- Finance (Diego): headcount / budget syncs
- Eng-SRE: on-call rota & paging runbook
- Security: trainings & compliance questions

Quick CLI snippets (DevEx):
- Request GitHub invite: `devex request-invite --email <email> --team eng-managers`
- Request CI token: `devex request-token --service=ci --scope=repo`
- Expedite laptop: `it-setup-bot create --type manager --priority high --name \"Full Name\"`

Priya: I'll publish this to Confluence and link templates (1:1, 30/60/90, headcount sync). Will post link here by EOD.

Nina (People Ops): Marta, send start date + legal name and I'll kick HR & IT flows.

onboard-bot: IT ticket created #IT-98321 for manager laptop provisioning (ETA: 3 business days).

Marta (Recruiter): Awesome 1 this is the right level of detail. Priya please ping when the Confluence link exists and I'll attach it to the offer. Thanks everyone!"
